decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and creatures to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Monastery Swiftspear, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to help dig for more threats and maintain card advantage. With a low curve and aggressive game plan, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to use creatures with abilities that can be searched for and put into play using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Nature's Rhythm. Leyline of Abundance helps generate mana to quickly ramp into powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for flexibility in finding answers to different situations. Agatha's Soul Cauldron can be used to bring back key creatures from the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and combo potential.

The deck focuses on assembling powerful Eldrazi creatures by utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple to ramp up mana quickly. It also utilizes sacrifice effects like Malevolent Rumble and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate value and control the board. The key strategy is to create a board state where you can overwhelm your opponent with large Eldrazi creatures and disruption spells while also generating incremental advantages through sacrificing and recurring creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the game and protect your combo. The deck seeks to win the game quickly by utilizing instant reanimation effects to overwhelm the opponent before they can set up their own game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and powerful support spells to quickly overwhelm your opponent. By playing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, backed up by strong removal like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, you can quickly close out the game. The deck also utilizes powerful anthems like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory to boost your team and push through damage. With a mix of creatures, removal, and support cards, this Boros Aggro deck aims to put pressure on your opponent and come out victorious.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures that can be blinked in and out of play to create value and disrupt opponents. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' strategies. Quantum Riddler and Solitude provide additional removal options, while Teferi, Time Raveler can help protect our board and disrupt opponents. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption through the use of blink effects.

The deck focuses on discarding cards from hand and using the graveyard as a resource to quickly put out powerful threats such as Hollow One, Vengevine, and Detective's Phoenix. By utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive gameplay style. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Street Wraith provide additional utility and reach to close out games efficiently. The deck is designed to quickly establish a threatening board presence and apply constant pressure to the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and using cards like Goryo's Vengeance to cheat them into play. It uses cards like Faithful Mending and Thoughtseize to manipulate the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly reanimate creatures and overwhelm the opponent with powerful combos, controlling the game with cards like Force of Negation and Solitude. It also includes cards like Ephemerate and Prismatic Ending for additional utility and control options.

The deck focuses on using ramp cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Eldrazi Temple to quickly get out Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also includes control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Ugin's Labyrinth to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control spells, while also utilizing cards like Fight Rigging and Disciple of Freyalise for additional support. The key strategy is to establish early board control and quickly ramp into massive Eldrazi threats to dominate the game.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to hit the opponent quickly and efficiently. With cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to provide additional support and value, the deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure while utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off the opponent. Overall, the deck focuses on building a strong board presence and swiftly defeating the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck revolves around using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand back from the graveyard. By using cards like Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and Solitude to remove threats, the deck aims to lock down the game until it can set up its combo. Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional utility and power to the deck, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and other mana sources to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also includes control elements like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats while controlling the board with removal spells and protective cards. By quickly ramping into Eldrazi creatures, the deck seeks to dominate the battlefield and secure victory through sheer power and versatility.

The deck revolves around creating a powerful combo with Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate massive amounts of tokens and buff them up. Utilizing Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga for ramp, the deck also includes disruptive elements like Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command. Emrakul, the Promised End serves as a game-ending threat, while cards like Malevolent Rumble provide removal. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of combo pieces, disruption, and efficient threats.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and card advantage to dominate the game. By consistently disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal, and board wipes like Supreme Verdict and Wrath of the Skies, while also generating card advantage with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Consult the Star Charts, this deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can win with either a powerful finisher or by milling the opponent out. The addition of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion enhances the deck's overall strategy.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creature plays with the ability to temporarily remove threats from the board through blinking effects. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, players can disrupt their opponent's strategies while maintaining a strong board presence with powerful creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk. Additionally, the inclusion of Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize helps control the opponent's graveyard and hand, keeping them on the back foot. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on creating infinite combos with cards like Grinding Station, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Mox Opal. By continuously milling cards from your own library and sacrificing artifacts, you can generate a powerful engine to control the game and disrupt your opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Tormod's Crypt and Metallic Rebuke to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opposing strategies. Loki, God of Mischief is also included to provide additional control options and further disrupt your opponent's plans. Overall, the deck aims to grind out wins through its synergistic combos and disruptive elements.
